scope: Independent audit probes of existing Claude loaders, fresh process per arm/path/codec/repetition; warm_buffered only, identical recorded paths; no source map/other arms in probe. Tracemalloc covers traced Python/NumPy allocations and small audit bookkeeping, excludes untraced native allocations. RSS is absolute process high-water mark including runtime/imports, not attributable cache bytes; baseline is also a high-water mark, not current RSS. Exact retained decoded bytes exclude index/objects/output/scratch. Only one output is kept and then deleted per step.
